title: Multi-target Triazole-Benzopyrone hybrids modulating cholinergic dysfunction, oxidative stress, and neuroinflammation through GFAP/NF-kappaB/APOE/NLRP3 axis in Alzheimer's disease.
authors: El-Mokaddem, Omar K; Elmasry, Ghada F; Salama, Abeer; Mansour, Heba M; Mahmoud, Walaa R; Ghany, Lina M A Abdel
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦阿尔茨海默病中三唑-苯并吡喃酮杂合物的多靶点调控，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为小分子与AChE酶，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a degenerative neurological disorder characterized by a deterioration in cognitive abilities, especially memory and learning. The main aim of this study is to evaluate the effects of our agents on oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, cognitive function, and behavioral performance in an LPS-induced AD animal model and comprehensive in vitro and in vivo assays. The synthesized compounds, namely 4b, 5b, 6, 8a-d, and 11a-c, revealed acetylcholinesterase inhibitory activity (3.50-5.91 nM) superior to that of the reference drug donepezil (6.33 nM). The IC(50) value of 11a the most active candidate was 3.50 nM against hAChE, with a significant reduction in amyloid-beta accumulation by 70% compared to LPS-treated groups, it also reduced neuronal damage, as evidenced by histopathological analysis. Compared to LPS treated groups, 11a decreased brain GFAP, NLRP3, NF-kappaB, APOE and MDA by 76%, 65%, 48%, 75%, and 59% respectively while increasing GSH by 81%. Molecular docking simulation, along with 100 ns molecular dynamics (MD) simulations conducted on the AChE-ligand complexes, demonstrated favorable conformations of ligand-protein complex throughout the simulations, predicting a dual binding to the CAS and PAS regions of the enzyme which is consistent with kinetic studies against hAChE. Moreover, the chemical stability and reactivity of the drug-target complex were evaluated using global and local reactive descriptors. These findings suggested that compound 11a possessed promising potential as a multi-target lead compound for the development of anti-Alzheimer treatments based on cholinergic, amyloidogenic, and neuroinflammation, through GFAP/NF-kappaB/APOE/NLRP3 signaling axis.
abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）是一种退行性神经系统疾病，其特征是认知能力，尤其是记忆和学习能力的衰退。本研究的主要目的是评估我们的化合物在脂多糖（LPS）诱导的AD动物模型中对氧化应激、神经炎症、认知功能和行为表现的影响，并通过全面的体外和体内实验进行验证。合成的化合物，即4b、5b、6、8a-d和11a-c，显示出优于参考药物多奈哌齐（donepezil，6.33 nM）的乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制活性（3.50-5.91 nM）。最具活性的候选化合物11a对hAChE的IC(50)值为3.50 nM，与LPS处理组相比，其显著减少了70%的淀粉样蛋白-β积累，并通过组织病理学分析证实其减轻了神经元损伤。与LPS处理组相比，11a分别将脑内GFAP、NLRP3、NF-kappaB、APOE和MDA水平降低了76%、65%、48%、75%和59%，同时将GSH水平提高了81%。分子对接模拟以及针对AChE-配体复合物进行的100 ns分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，在整个模拟过程中展示了配体-蛋白质复合物的有利构象，预测其与酶的CAS和PAS区域发生双重结合，这与针对hAChE的动力学研究结果一致。此外，通过全局和局部反应性描述符评估了药物-靶点复合物的化学稳定性和反应性。这些发现表明，化合物11a作为多靶点先导化合物，在基于胆碱能、淀粉样变性和神经炎症途径，通过GFAP/NF-kappaB/APOE/NLRP3信号轴开发抗阿尔茨海默病治疗方面具有潜在前景。
